In 2026 management of this data is being transferred to SEACAR
In this file we prepare a transformation of the dataset for SEACAR ingestion,
and perform some checks.

The data here should align with standards described in ...

```{R setup}
librarian::shelf(
  dplyr,
  glue,
  here,
  tidyr
)
```

```{R, load data, convert to SEACAR format, save .csv}
source(here("R/getAllData.R"))
df_all <- getAllData()

source(here("R/mutateWINToSEACAR.R"))
df <- mutateWINToSEACAR.R(df_all)

# write SEACAR .csv
write.csv(df, here("data", "exports", "allDataSEACAR.csv"))

```

## Summary of column completeness

```{R, skimr of columns}
skimr::skim(df)
```

## List unique analyte names

```{R, list unique analyte names}
unique(df$ParameterName)
```
